description_en: Obtains the verification code that is required when you bind an advanced office network to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 将高级办公网络加入其他阿里云账号下的云企业网实例时，需要调用此接口获取验证码
kebab_example: aliyun ecd send-verify-code --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --verify-code-action eds_cenID_securityverification --extra-info cenOwnerId_:_1234567890000000,_cenId_:_cen-3weq30r6t0s7t40000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendVerifyCode

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The action that you want to perform by using the verification code.

Valid value:

- eds\_cenID\_securityverification: Use the verification code to verify the CEN instance.
parameters.help_en:
The action that you want to perform by using the verification code.

Valid value:

- eds\_cenID\_securityverification: Use the verification code to verify the CEN instance
parameters.name: verify_code_action

parameters.description_en:
The information that is required to send the verification code, in JSON format. When you verify the CEN instance of another Alibaba Cloud account, you must provide the ID of the CEN instance and the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the instance belongs.

- CenId: the ID of the CEN instance.

- CenOwnerId: the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs.

> If you own the CEN instance, skip this parameter. If you do not own the CEN instance, specify the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the CEN instance.
parameters.description_zh:
发送验证码所需的相关信息，为JSON格式。验证云企业网CEN时，需提供云企业实例ID及其所属的阿里云账号ID。
- CenId：云企业网实例ID。 
- CenOwnerId：云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。 

> 如果配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。 如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID。
